text: Let's keep Cloud cosy! Draw around the fixed ledges, or fit your line into a gap. Then let the bees fly.
This cave needs a little door. Draw down beside the ledge, then turn along the low rock.
The opening is on the other side. Draw down beside the ledge, then turn onto the rock.
There's a gap in the roof. Draw a little curved cap that rests on both edges.
Can you fill the notch? Draw a little cup shape and rest it on the two shelves.
There's a side window. Draw three sides of a little box around its edges.
Draw a big upside-down cup over Cloud. Let the little ledge catch the roof.
Start above the shelf, draw across, then turn down to make a cosy corner.
Here's a high ledge and a low rock. Draw across, down, and across again.
Let's give this garden bowl a rainbow roof. Rest each end on the stone rim.
This tunnel needs a short door. Draw down, then turn along the low rock.
